svg.title: How embed.py turns amino acids and 3Di letters into the diffusion tensor
svg.desc: embed_sequence looks up five OmegAMP features per amino acid in OMEGAMP_AA_SCALE, min-max normalizes each channel to [-1, 1] over the 20 amino acids and appends residue_present, 1 on residues and 0 on padding. encode_3di maps each 3Di letter to an ID from 1 to 20, PAD 0, and foldseek_3di_codebook gives two unnormalized Foldseek coordinates, (0, 0) on PAD. embed_diffusion_sequence with joint_3di=True concatenates both into a [pad_to, 8] tensor that the model reads transposed as [8, 70], with zeros in the padded tail.
svg.text: min and max per channel over the 20 amino acids
